network_domain_allowlist.justification: Enterprise-grade domain allowlist: Atlassian-owned suffixes (.atlassian.net primary, .atl-paas.net PaaS, .atlassian.com corporate, .atlassian-dev.net CDN) for dynamic infrastructure. Third-party services pinned to exact observed hosts only (no wildcard suffixes): CloudFront CDN, Gravatar avatars, WordPress Gravatar CDN, Sentry error tracking. Fail-closed on any unlisted domain.
